$comment: Drives capture.mjs. Paths are relative to the capture/ folder. Edit this file to add a section, a variant, a snippet or a page; the script needs no change. A section id is `<folder>` or `<folder>--<variant>`: the variant files get the `--<variant>` suffix inside the same folder. Locators: `selector` (+ optional `selectorIndex`, `containsText`) or `headingText` (+ optional `headingSelector`, `closest`).

sections.title: vs / Side-by-side (sticky)
sections.variant: 5 blocks, dark, sticky illustration on desktop
sections.comment: side-by-side: 5 text blocks (.vs-sticky_item), each with a layered illustration (.vs-visual). Live: on desktop the illustration is sticky and swaps as the matching text block reaches the middle of the viewport (GSAP ScrollTrigger). Here the static-state CSS at the end of the <style> puts each illustration next to its text. The data-build, data-motion and data-depth attributes describe the GSAP build steps.
sections.knownDifference: static state: each illustration next to its text (live: one sticky illustration, inactive text dimmed)
